items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: I knew Albert de Conje and he's Dolph de Conje.

ctx.x: They all come from down there. He's Pete de Conje and all them. Albert de Conje, all the on there.
I knew Albert de Conje and he's Dolph de Conje. I knew all them.
I don't know what he is but I don't see him anymore.
